C0809.title: XZ Utils Backdoor Incident (2024)
C0809.summary: Attackers embedded a malicious backdoor in versions 5.6.0 and 5.6.1 of the widely used open-source compression tool XZ Utils by tampering with specific liblzma functions, bypassing sshd authentication to achieve unauthorized access. The incident impacted multiple major Linux distributions including Fedora, openSUSE, Debian testing, and Arch Linux, representing a severe case of upstream open-source
